correctness.rationale: Under irreducibility, m=2 or 4, 9|a and b≡1 mod9, the monic φ=x²+1 is irreducible mod3 and F≡φ³. Exact φ-expansions have coefficients c1,c2 with v3=1 and c0 divisible by 9; the φ-Newton polygon vertices include (1,1),(3,0), with exactly one positive integer lattice point (1,1) on/below the principal polygon and degree-one residual polynomials. Therefore Ore 3-regular equality gives v3(root index)=degφ=2. If c0=0 the polynomial is divisible by φ and hence reducible, so that case is vacuous under assumptions. Independently verified both symbolic expansions and direct SymPy integral bases for irreducible x^6+9x²+19 and x^6+9x⁴+19, obtaining root index 9 in both cases.
